articles.title: Botswana says 'alarming rise' in citizens lured to Russia's war
articles.description: An alarming number of Botswana nationals are being forced into combat in Russia's war against Ukraine after falling for deceptive recruitment schemes, the government said Saturday .

articles.title: Spain faces hottest week of summer with temperatures up to 45°C next week
articles.description: Spain's Met Office Aemet says from Tuesday the country will face its third summer heatwave, with highs up to 45°C, as major wildfires rage in Zaragoza and Guadalajara.
